prerequisites: Basic knowledge in production and logistics

learning_outcomes.text: Students can apply tools and methods of production planning and control to practice-oriented examples.
They are able to evaluate the planning results with regard to plausibility and efficiency and to assess their effects on holistic business processes between suppliers and customers.

Students understand the processes in the sub-processes of production planning and are able to evaluate the information exchanged between the sub-processes and to assess their effects on other planning steps.

syllabus_topics: Operational tasks in production planning and control
Connection between development and the production processes to be planned (manufacturing-oriented product design)
Market requirements for production processes and their control
Typical IT application areas to support production planning and control
Information flow and associated data structures in IT systems (master data management: material master, bills of materials, work center master, routings)
Program planning and primary demand determination
Material requirements planning with bill of materials explosion and net requirements planning
Order processing and production order management
Simulation tools for production planning and controlling
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the module examination.
